name: Eylis, the Punished Dreamer
speaker: entity:eylis_the_punished_dreamer
lines: Ah, a curious one! Look at you then. Poking your nose into matters you have no place in... 'tis a shame, truly.

Well.. on matters like these, I tend to make deals with those who snoop around too much. Usually, to quiet them, or face a consequence. Alas, your soul is already *full of ideals* to make an offer to convince you. You have no place here, whelp.

Bah! As if you're deserving of any explanation. *She gives you a sharp glare, staring you down with dark intent.* Listen to me carefully, as I'm only going to say this once. Do not interfere with our operations. Do not seek us out. If you become an obstacle to me, you'll soon sink too.
Hey, look who it is. You got a reason for coming in here? I've got deals to make, nations to toy with, the usual.

*She laughs, clearly amused by your question.* What is it that you want? Money? Power? To feel good about yourself? You did read the contract I gave you, yes? Go out and take jobs from the board, whelp.

Oh, me and her? We go way back. Long time friendship, you see! *She holds back a scoff.* I'd simply been at the right place at the right time, little Knife. Anything more than that.. I'm sworn to secrecy. *She holds her finger in front of her mouth, making a 'shush' expression with it.* Now then, run along.

Oh, that little thing... Keep it in the back of your head for now, little whelp. You're still dull, desperately in need for being tempered and refined. But, I am watching you, little Knife. You're.. different, from the rest. I'll be keeping a close eye...
